Prashant Kishor alleges welfare denial for votes in Bihar bypoll

Political strategist Prashant Kishor alleged that women are being told they will not receive welfare benefits if they do not vote for the BJP in the Bankipur by-election campaign. Kishor also challenged the government on this issue and claimed the BJP is using 'Jeevika Didis' to intimidate voters. The BJP, in turn, accused Kishor of insulting women out of fear of losing the election. Chief Minister Nitish Kumar has also joined the campaign for the BJP in Bankipur.
